title: Đắt quá: bargaining at the market

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Tone names today.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say the name for a flat tone —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ngang] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say the name for a falling tone —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu huyền] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say the name for a high, rising tone —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu sắc] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say the name for a dipping tone —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu hỏi] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say the other dipping-tone mark, same sound in the south —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu ngã] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say the name for a low, cut-off tone —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: dấu nặng] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI: Cái này đắt quá. [EN: Quick pass over today's words.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Too expensive —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: đắt quá] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Cheap —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: rẻ] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: To discount —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: giảm giá] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Can you, or is that okay —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: được không] [EN: Good.]
